name: Eikonal reformulation

step_7C.key_finding: Kendall variance-based weighting downweights L_eik because constraint residual is identified as high-noise; opposite of what is needed

step_7D.key_finding: Bertsekas reasonableness checks pass; strict criteria fail; Pearson regressed to negative

step_8.key_finding: ALM did not reach asymptotic regime; mu saturated at mu_max on all 6 cells; Pearson stayed <= 0 on all cells with finite values

step_7E.key_finding: capacity increase did not produce strict 7D margins; multi-branch admissibility is supervision-bound not capacity-bound

structural_limitation.name: multi_branch_admissibility_under_sparse_BC_supervision
structural_limitation.description: ALM enforces ||grad T||^2 approx c^2 globally; under sparse BC supervision (only success/collision states anchor T), network locks onto a solution branch that does not align with empirical T_obs across visited states; capacity increase does not resolve since the issue is supervision-bound

tier_1_framing: Eikonal-PINN with ALM-hybrid loss formulation, exhibiting weaker action discrimination than HJB and Soft-HJB due to multi-branch admissibility under sparse BC supervision in discrete-action behavioral driving
